active_agent_facing_markdown_definition: Tracked *.md excluding raw/** immutable captures, .wiki/** mechanism state, and wiki/_* generated indexes.

separate_source_custody_measure.interpretation: The larger total includes immutable source copies and generated provenance pages; these are excluded from normal agent navigation and default wiki search.

default_orientation.interpretation: Orientation is not claimed to use fewer bytes. It is claimed to reach the required fact classes deterministically without initial search while overall active documentation shrinks.
